scripts.dev: npm exec -w @lamton/shared -- tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm exec -w @lamton/api -- tsx watch src/index.ts" "npm exec -w @lamton/web -- vite"
scripts.build: npm exec -w @lamton/shared -- tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm exec -w @lamton/api -- tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm exec -w @lamton/web -- tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm exec -w @lamton/web -- vite build
scripts.typecheck: npm exec -w @lamton/shared -- tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm exec -w @lamton/api -- tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm exec -w @lamton/web -- tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm exec -w @lamton/shared -- tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm exec -w @lamton/api -- vitest run && npm exec -w @lamton/web -- vitest run
